Two replicas in a read-scale Availability Group (CLUSTER_TYPE = NONE): synchronous commit, automatic seeding, readable secondary; failover is a manual FORCE_FAILOVER_ALLOW_DATA_LOSS on the secondary.

ddl:
CREATE TABLE customers (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  email NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  country_code NVARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  tier NVARCHAR(10) NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME2(6) NOT NULL,
  attrs NVARCHAR(MAX),
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  parent_id INT,
  name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  depth INT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE products (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  category_id INT NOT NULL,
  sku NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  name NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
  description NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,
  price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  attrs NVARCHAR(MAX),
  active BIT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (category_id) REFERENCES categories (id)
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  customer_id INT NOT NULL,
  status NVARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,
  ordered_at DATETIME2(6) NOT NULL,
  total_amount DECIMAL(14,2) NOT NULL,
  shipping_country NVARCHAR(2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES customers (id)
)

CREATE TABLE order_items (
  id INT NOT NULL,
  order_id INT NOT NULL,
  product_id INT NOT NULL,
  qty INT NOT NULL,
  unit_price DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (id)
)

CREATE TABLE events (
  id BIGINT NOT NULL,
  customer_id INT NOT NULL,
  event_type NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
  occurred_at DATETIME2(6) NOT NULL,
  payload NVARCHAR(MAX),
  value_num DECIMAL(12,4) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory (
  product_id INT NOT NULL,
  warehouse_id INT NOT NULL,
  qty INT NOT NULL,
  updated_at DATETIME2(6) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id, warehouse_id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_customers_email ON customers (email)

full.tool: BACKUP DATABASE WITH COMPRESSION, CHECKSUM + RESTORE VERIFYONLY
full.notes: compressed, checksummed full backup verified with RESTORE VERIFYONLY and restored under a new name (WITH MOVE); history in msdb.dbo.backupset

steps.name: BACKUP DATABASE (full)
steps.cmd: BACKUP DATABASE [lab] TO DISK = N'/backups/lab-full.bak' WITH INIT, COMPRESSION, CHECKSUM, STATS = 25

steps.name: RESTORE VERIFYONLY
steps.cmd: RESTORE VERIFYONLY FROM DISK = N'/backups/lab-full.bak' WITH CHECKSUM

steps.name: backup history
steps.cmd: SELECT TOP 1 backup_size, compressed_backup_size, DATEDIFF(ms, backup_start_date, backup_finish_date) FROM msdb.dbo.backupset WHERE database_name = N'lab' AND type = 'D' ORDER BY backup_finish_date DESC

steps.name: drop lab_restore
steps.cmd: IF DB_ID(N'lab_restore') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER DATABASE [lab_restore] SET SINGLE_USER WITH ROLLBACK IMMEDIATE; DROP DATABASE [lab_restore]; END

log_pitr.tool: BACKUP LOG + RESTORE LOG WITH STOPAT
log_pitr.notes: FULL recovery model: the log backup carries every transaction; RESTORE LOG ... WITH STOPAT replays up to the timestamp before the DELETE

steps.name: BACKUP LOG
steps.cmd: BACKUP LOG [lab] TO DISK = N'/backups/lab-log1.trn' WITH INIT, COMPRESSION, CHECKSUM
